module: Adds to the freeroam configurator (the level selection screen in freeroam) the freeroam-specific options: traffic mode (disabled, parked cars, normal, police), time of day, date and day progression (day/night cycle). It reacts to the hooks onFreeroamConfiguratorGetOptions (menu construction) and onFreeroamConfiguratorApplyOptions (chosen values) and writes the choices into freeroam_freeroam.spawningOptionsHelper. A modder can copy this pattern to add their own options.
notes: The traffic group has order = 100, the time/date group has order = 200; each option is a table {label, icon, value, key, type, options...} where type is 'select' or 'date'.
Without traffic support or without time options (core_levels.getTimeOfDayOptions), a disabled option with an "unsupported" text is added instead.
Traffic modes -> spawningOptionsHelper: disabled = nothing; parkedOnly = trafficParked only; enabled = trafficMode + trafficParked; police = all three enabled.
The default date is level.defaultDate (year, month, day) or, failing that, June 20, 2026, at 12:00 (os.time).
The options' 'value' values are defaults; they are replaced by the current configuration on the UI side.

getDefaultEnvironmentDate.desc: Default date of a level for the environment.

returns.desc: os.time() timestamp of the date (time set to 12:00).

onFreeroamConfiguratorApplyOptions.desc: Hook called when the player confirms the configurator: passes the options traffic_trafficMode, environment_timeOfDay, environment_date and environment_timePlay to freeroam_freeroam.spawningOptionsHelper (the traffic mode is converted into trafficMode, trafficPolice and trafficParked).

options.desc: Chosen values, keyed by the option's key.

onFreeroamConfiguratorGetOptions.desc: Hook called when the configurator builds its options for a level: inserts the traffic and time/date/day progression groups into options.

options.desc: List of option groups to complete (modified in place).
